mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past three months signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their three-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their three-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 200, or the Rank IC for the high-inflation regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 2000.0 thousand units over the past three months signals a contraction in the housing market, which reduces construction activity and consumer wealth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST falls below 2000.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payroll employment and decline in the unemployment rate above their three-month moving averages indicates a rapidly improving labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls above their three-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 > 11000 billion dollars), the economy is expanding robustly, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 11000, or the Rank IC for the strong growth regime is below 0.02.
